definitions.gloss: public relations bulletin; newsletter; informational magazine
definitions.explanation: Published by local governments, organizations, and companies.

examples.japanese: {広報|こうほう}{誌|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: Event information is listed in the newsletter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}される→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧{広報|こうほう}{誌|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧や⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The monthly newsletter contains local events and health check-up information.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧ (public relations, publicity) + {誌|し} (magazine, journal). Refers to newsletters or informational publications issued by municipalities, organizations, universities, or companies to distribute news and announcements to their constituents or members.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広報|こうほう}{誌|し}: city newsletter
- {広報|こうほう}{誌|し}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to publish a newsletter
- {広報|こうほう}{誌|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}する→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧: to publish in the newsletter
- ⟦{月刊|げっかん}→月刊：16257_gekkan⟧{広報|こうほう}{誌|し}: monthly newsletter

USAGE:
In Japan, every municipality publishes a {広報|こうほう}{誌|し} that is delivered to all households. These typically contain information about local services, events, tax deadlines, disaster preparedness, and health programs. Many residents rely on them as a primary source of local government information.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {会報|かいほう}: association newsletter (for members of a specific group)
- {社報|しゃほう}: company newsletter (internal corporate publication)
- ⟦{回覧板|かいらんばん}→回覧板：10192_kairanban⟧: neighborhood circular board (passed between houses)
